title: Part (c): the slice homotopy identity in degree k + 1
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, β ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and θ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) (β : TestFormOn univ (k + 1), θ : TestFormOn univ k). Write ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)), Jv := ι(0, v), e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 and d := exteriorDerivative (Mathlib extDeriv). Suppose θ(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ∫_0^1 β(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) dt for all x ∈ ℝ^N and v ∈ (ℝ^N)^k. Then for all x ∈ ℝ^N and v = (v_0, …, v_k) ∈ (ℝ^N)^{k+1}: ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_0, …, Jv_k) dt = β(ι(1, x))(Jv_0, …, Jv_k) − β(ι(0, x))(Jv_0, …, Jv_k) − dθ(x)(v_0, …, v_k).
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (θ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → ∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) - (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) - exteriorDerivative (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v
